Primary tumour of the placenta, outside the 13 axes; possible metastases do not establish common involvement of another organ.

Congenital fourth cranial nerve dysfunction defines persistent superior oblique weakness and ocular misalignment.
Renal ciliopathy classified with Joubert syndrome and cerebellar vermis hypoplasia; retinal degeneration is occasional (5-29%) and excluded.
Congenital foot and ankle bone/joint malalignment, often with lower-leg muscle hypoplasia and other lower-limb malformations.
Immune-mediated Crohn inflammation affecting oral tissues; the mouth belongs to the gastrointestinal axis.
Metaplastic lesion of urinary tract urothelium, including bladder and urethra; all these sites belong to the renal axis.
Umbrella disease of the nose; nasal and sinus structures belong to the pulmonary axis.
